name: Lise René Xana
original_name: リーズ・ルネ・シャナ
source:
"Shall we go, my Jeanne d'Arc? To protect the people from suffering."

The protagonist’s childhood friend, raised in a family that has served the Jeanne d’Arc lineage for generations. 

A gentle young man overflowing with kindness and compassion, blessed with striking good looks. Though his role as a squire is to protect the heroine, she is far stronger—both physically and mentally—leaving him more often the one being protected instead.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/crazy_chain/chara/]official website[/url]]
